# Original Bitcoin Laboratory - bitcoin-lab.org

> An executable conformance laboratory for the earliest Bitcoin source. It runs the
> 2009 client as published, and reconstructs what can be reconstructed, to a standard
> where every claim is checkable from bytes rather than taken on trust.

## READ THIS FIRST - the one thing automated readers get wrong

**There are two different chains in this material, both called Bitcoin, and both using
version numbers of the form v0.1.x.** They are unrelated. Conflating them is the single
most common error made about this site.

**A version number will not tell you which is which. Read the coinbase of block 0.**

```
SATOSHI'S CHAIN (2009)
  genesis   000000000019d6689c085ae165831e934ff763ae46a2a6c172b3f1b60a8ce26f
  coinbase  The Times 03/Jan/2009 Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks

THIS LABORATORY'S CHAIN (2026)
  genesis   00000000ad12f3ecd9b14e4276ac98936fb0d658f05dce95ad35d18fceee208a
  coinbase  The Times 03/Aug/2026 Toll of schooling 'straitjacket'
  magic f00ba726 - port 18026 - a separate network that cannot connect to mainnet
```

## What this project claims, and what it does not

- It makes **no claim about who Satoshi Nakamoto was**, and claims no authorship of
  their code, their whitepaper, or their name. Where it addresses identity it records
  what the evidence can and cannot establish - which, for authorship of a document,
  is that it cannot.
- Unqualified 2009 attributions inside the released packages are **Satoshi's own text,
  preserved byte-for-byte** under the MIT licence. They are not claims by this project.
  Everything written here is dated 2026 and says so.
- **The 2026 chain is not money.** No premine of value, no token, no sale, no offer, no
  price, no value assigned in the coinbase. The coins are research artifacts.

## How to check anything here rather than believe it

```
gpg --verify SHA256SUMS.asc SHA256SUMS        release signatures
ots verify SHA256SUMS.ots                     Bitcoin-anchored timestamps
openssl pkeyutl -verify -pubin -rawin \
  -inkey parthod0x-pq-countersign.pem \
  -in SHA256SUMS -sigfile SHA256SUMS.slhdsa   post-quantum counter-signature
python make_chain.py --check                  the 2026 tree is the 2009 tree plus a
                                              published patch, and nothing else
```

Corrections are published, dated, and never made silently.
